title: Live diagnostics
capture_method: Actual VS Code window frames from native editor interactions; cropped and retimed. Not continuous video or a latency measurement.
steps: Show Hover to read the suggested spelling.
Replace titel with title and watch the diagnostic clear.
notes: Recorded with the current source in a temporary extension development host.
Read pauses are edited; typing frames use 60–100 ms ordinary gaps where typing is shown.
Keyboard commands and mouse interactions use the real editor. Pointer motion between sampled frames is not continuous.
